title: Polynomial size for addition
statement: The language of Boolean-word encodings of addition is recognized by a family of well-formed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two whose size is bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the addition language or the polynomial bound's coefficients and degree.
